item.title: Top 5 Steps to Navigate Blazor Server App Template Issues in .NET 8
item.description:
Are you facing challenges finding the Blazor Server App template in .NET 8? This guide provides essential steps to troubleshoot and resolve template availability issues using both Visual Studio and the .NET CLI.

Top-5-Steps-to-Navigate-Blazor-Server-App-Template-Issues-in-.NET-8

Step 1: Understanding Template Availability

Ensure you understand the template availability differences between Visual Studio and the .NET CLI.

Check Visual Studio's Blazor template options carefully. Sometimes, selecting 'Blazor Web App' and specifying 'Server' during setup generates the Blazor Server App structure.
